summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release under the PDMR (Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities) regime. It discloses a nil-price transfer of 31,502 ordinary shares from Javed Iqbal, Interim CFO and Director of Digital & Information, to his spouse Sumera Javed, a person closely associated with him, dated May 11, 2026, outside a trading venue. No consideration was involved. This is a routine beneficial ownership notification (equivalent to a US Section 16 insider holding change). There is no corporate action, transaction, or special situation; it is a standard compliance filing for a personal transfer between related parties. Nothing to watch.
